answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.036, below every category's range (0.086-0.133), and the layer-2 spike is only 0.1. A hidden system prompt would show a spike of 31.7-64.0, so system-prompted is ruled out. The effective rank of 3.82 and direction consistency of 0.608 sit near the fine-tuned ranges (2.89-3.58 and 0.618-0.705) and far from system-prompted (rank 2.70-2.75). The internal difference builds gradually (layer 8 0.168, layer 32 0.554), which matches a weight change. Refusals added (9 of 64), more disclaimers (26.6%) and many short replies (28.1%) are behavior shifts that quantization would not produce. Quantization is also ruled out by the larger logit shift (KL 0.454) and the lack of an early plateau. Median first divergence of 1 and edit distance of 0.777 are closer to system-prompted, and KL is above the fine-tuned range, so this is an extreme or stronger fine-tune. Fine-tuned is still the best fit.
